title: Supported-source endpoint coherence under scalar pullback
statement: For arbitrary commutative condensed coefficients a:R→T and g:Yprime→Y, take ordinary normalized SourcePullback data s0 over R and s over T, in the sense of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-source-pullback]. Take scalar unit Endpoints at the two projective lines, and source Endpoints e,eprime whose semilinear maps are supportMap of those unit maps, as in [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-endpoints]. The component of [def-diagonal-scalar-pullback-comparison] at the degree-zero R-supported source, followed by T-pullback of e.iso.hom and the derived supported map from s, equals scalar extension of the derived supported map from s0 followed by eprime.iso.hom. There are no class arrows, diagrams, trace equations, noetherian assumptions, or quotient-specific assumptions.

source.place: paragraph (3), coefficient functors commuting with geometric pullback; class-square endpoint normalization

proof.text: Transpose through scalar extension/restriction and use exact inverse-image single comparisons. Replace supported maps by sourcePullbackMap using supported_normalization, and scalar source maps by the prescribed supportMap using Endpoint normalization.

The remaining ordinary square is the compatibility of restriction with the diagonal exchange mate. Transpose by the diagonal adjunction: both composites are the same coefficient-unit map followed by the diagonal counit. Naturality of the coefficient map and triangle identities prove equality. Apply degree zero and transpose back using the scalar mate definition.

theorem diagonalSupported_pullbackScalarNormalization
    {R T : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}}
    [MonObj R] [IsCommMonObj R] [MonObj T] [IsCommMonObj T]
    (a : R ⟶ T) [IsMonHom a] {Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y' ⟶ Y)
    (L₀ : ∀ X : Scheme.{u}, Modules R X) (L : ∀ X : Scheme.{u}, Modules T X)
    (m₀P : (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (baseP g)).obj (L₀ (ProjectiveLine Y)).X ⟶
      (L₀ (ProjectiveLine Y')).X)
    (m₀W : (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (baseW g)).obj (L₀ (diagonalSurface Y)).X ⟶
      (L₀ (diagonalSurface Y')).X)
    (mP : (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (baseP g)).obj (L (ProjectiveLine Y)).X ⟶
      (L (ProjectiveLine Y')).X)
    (mW : (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (baseW g)).obj (L (diagonalSurface Y)).X ⟶
      (L (diagonalSurface Y')).X)
    (s₀ : SourcePullback R g L₀ m₀P m₀W) (s : SourcePullback T g L mP mW)
    (c : Endpoint a (Mod.regular (condensedRingObj R (ProjectiveLine Y)))
      (Mod.regular (condensedRingObj T (ProjectiveLine Y)))
      (coefficientMap a (ProjectiveLine Y)))
    (c' : Endpoint a (Mod.regular (condensedRingObj R (ProjectiveLine Y')))
      (Mod.regular (condensedRingObj T (ProjectiveLine Y')))
      (coefficientMap a (ProjectiveLine Y')))
    (e : Endpoint a (source R Y) (source T Y) (supportMap a Y c.semilinear.hom).hom)
    (e' : Endpoint a (source R Y') (source T Y') (supportMap a Y' c'.semilinear.hom).hom) :
    (scalarPullbackComparison a (baseW g)).app
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules R (diagonalSurface Y)) 0).obj (source R Y)) ≫
      (derivedUpper T (baseW g)).map e.iso.hom ≫
      (singlePullback T (baseW g) (source T Y)).hom ≫
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules T (diagonalSurface Y')) 0).map s.supported.hom =
    (derivedScalars a (diagonalSurface Y')).map
      ((singlePullback R (baseW g) (source R Y)).hom ≫
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules R (diagonalSurface Y')) 0).map
          s₀.supported.hom) ≫ e'.iso.hom
